messages:
mia (partnerships): Heads-up — carrier just flagged a customs hold on the OrionCloud A2 rack shipment into NL port. This is the batch that maps to several Dedicated reservations and marketplace SKUs for EU customers. Copy of carrier note attached in email.
devin (logistics): Ugh. tracking? how long a hold? any reason listed?
mia (partnerships): Tracking: TRACK-EU-998122. Reason: missing CE declaration on a firmware component flagged by customs. Carrier ETA -> 'awaiting docs', no firm clearance time.
leo (ops): Can we swap reservations to other racks in the same window? what's inventory flexibility in the reservation pool?
sarah (sales): Which customers will see degraded capacity? We need a heads-up for accounts on reserved Dedicated. Also, rumored joint announcement with Orion next week — do we postpone?
mia (partnerships): Affected reservations: 4 Dedicated pools (APAC unaffected) + 3 marketplace SKUs (eu-2-small, eu-2-medium, eu-2-large). Potentially impacts the canary for Orion joint launch.
elliot (marketplace): If we mark eu-2-medium as "temporary limited" in marketplace, do we need legal review? I can push a short notice banner but want wording approved.
rachel (legal): Quick review ok for a banner. Avoid admission of fault. Recommend: "Temporary fulfillment delay due to carrier customs processing. We expect updates within 72 hours." Don't promise credits until we know impact.
devin (logistics): Ops options: 1) supplier re-ship from alternative EU depot (48–72h transit) 2) airfreight from US (24–36h, higher cost) 3) swap to other dedicated pools in EU if customers accept minor config change. Need decision within 2 hours to reserve air slot.
mia (partnerships): @sarah do we block the joint Orion announcement for a week? Orion PM says they want go/no-go by EOD.
sarah (sales): Ask Orion for contingency messaging first. If we can guarantee marketplace availability for the launch segment (eu-2-small + fallback to eu-2-medium), we can keep timeline. If not, punt announcement.
leo (ops): I'm checking pool slack now — we have 2 spare racks in region eu-west-1 but they'd require reassign and IP migration; estimated ops work ~6h. Could be faster if Orion accepts temporary IP mapping.
devin (logistics): I filed an expedited docs request with carrier, and emailed the supplier for a re-ship quote. Carrier gave a docket ID: DOC-5591. Putting in escalation.
mia (partnerships): Proposed immediate actions: 1) marketplace banner draft (elliot + rachel) 2) offer Orion a reserved fallback from eu-west-1 (leo to confirm ops ETA) 3) if fallback > 12h, authorize airfreight (finance ok?) 4) notify impacted customers with soften language. Agree?
rachel (legal): Banner draft OK. For customer notices, avoid SLA/RMA language; offer credit templates only after we know confirmed delay >48h.
sarah (sales): Finance needs cost estimate for airfreight. @elliot prepare marketplace banner + flag any billing implications for SKUs.
elliot (marketplace): Banner draft: "We’re experiencing temporary fulfillment delays for select EU Dedicated SKUs due to carrier processing. We’re working with our logistics partners to resolve and will update within 72 hours. Customers with reservations may be offered alternative pools or expedited delivery." Sending to @rachel now.
devin (logistics): Airfreight quote from partner: +€12k per rack, 24–36h. Supplier re-ship quote: +€1.2k per rack, 48–72h (but needs supplier signoff). If we go air, need PO + customs broker pre-clear.
leo (ops): I can stand up the fallback racks and do IP cutover tonight if leadership approves 6h ops window. We’ll need a maintenance window and coordinate with oncall.
mia (partnerships): Leadership ask: prioritize customer SLAs -> fallback ops first. Airfreight only for top 2 enterprise customers if they demand it. @sarah confirm top 2 names so we can authorize.
sarah (sales): Top two: AcmePay and BrightLegal. I'll ping their CSMs and ask preference; I can also hold public announcement until I hear back.
devin (logistics): Carrier updated: customs requested additional supplier certificate. Supplier says they can provide within 6h. If so, clearance may be same-day. I'll mirror updates in this thread.
mia (partnerships): Thanks. I'll update Orion lead and pause public joint announcement until we have final clarity by EOD. If supplier cert arrives <6h we keep launch. If not, we fallback to ops plan and consider limited air for AcmePay/BrightLegal.
orion-bizbot: Automated update from Orion partner portal: "Orion PM acknowledged possible delay and requested contingency messaging by 18:00 CET."
sarah (sales): Pinged CSMs. AcmePay prefers air (they pay). BrightLegal says fallback pool is acceptable.
leo (ops): Ops ready. I'll reserve the maintenance slot for 20:00 CET and notify oncall. Need final sign-off by 19:00.
mia (partnerships): Final: waiting on supplier cert. If no cert by 18:30 -> ops fallback + notify marketplace banner at 19:00. If cert arrives, cancel ops and proceed with original plan. I'll post updates. :pray:
devin (logistics): update at 17:58 CET: supplier uploaded certificate, carrier acked receipt. Clearance queued. Will confirm when cleared.
mia (partnerships): update 18:22 CET: carrier cleared shipment; customs released at 18:15 CET. No ops action required. Orion notified and we keep joint announcement. Closing loop — thanks everyone. :tada:
